title: The retrieved craft may have been a living being

tellings.quote: itself could have been a living being

plain: A craft said to have been recovered by the US government "could have been a living being" itself, according to John Blitch, a former scientist at DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency for advanced technology. He raises this about a craft connected to Jake Barber, another figure who has spoken publicly about recovered craft, and offers it as a possibility, not as something he saw.
